note: Human-curated feed of IRCC policy changes that affect this site's rules. New candidates are flagged by scripts/policy-monitor.mjs and added here after manual verification.

updates.title: New Express Entry category: senior managers with Canadian work experience
updates.summary: IRCC's official rounds feed shows draws for a new 2026 category, 'Senior managers with Canadian Work Experience' (first round: 250 invitations at a 429 cutoff on March 5, 2026). If you manage at TEER 0 level with Canadian experience, this stream may invite at far lower scores than general CEC rounds.

updates.title: Hong Kong PR pathways extended; dedicated open work permit closed
updates.summary: The public policy giving HKSAR/BNO passport holders direct PR routes (Stream A for Canadian graduates, Stream B after 1 year of any in-Canada work, both at CLB 5 with no points grid) currently runs to August 31, 2026. The dedicated Hong Kong open work permit closed to new applications in February 2025 — entry now happens via study or regular work permits. The planner models both streams.

updates.title: 2026–2028 Immigration Levels Plan
updates.summary: Permanent resident admissions stabilize around 380,000 for 2026 after two years of reductions. A majority of admissions are expected to come from people already in Canada, which strengthens in-Canada routes like the Canadian Experience Class.

updates.title: Study permit cost-of-living requirement raised to $22,895
updates.summary: Single study permit applicants outside Quebec must now show $22,895 CAD in available funds, plus first-year tuition and travel costs. Our study pathway cost estimates reflect the new amount.

updates.title: Job offer points removed from the CRS
updates.summary: IRCC removed the 50/200 additional CRS points for arranged employment. A valid job offer no longer raises your Express Entry score — our calculator reflects this. A job offer can still matter for FSW eligibility and work permits.

updates.title: 2025 Express Entry categories: education added, transport removed
updates.summary: Category-based draws now cover French proficiency, healthcare & social services, STEM, trades, education, and agriculture & agri-food occupations. Education occupations (teachers, ECEs, instructors of persons with disabilities) were added; transport was removed.

updates.title: PGWP language and field-of-study requirements
updates.summary: Post-graduation work permit applicants now need CLB 7 (university graduates) or CLB 5 (college graduates). College graduates must also have studied in a field linked to long-term shortage occupations; university degree holders are exempt from the field restriction.

updates.title: Permanent residence fees increased
updates.summary: The Express Entry processing fee rose to $950 and the right-of-permanent-residence fee to $575 per adult. Cost estimates on this site use the new amounts.

updates.title: Study permit caps and provincial attestation letters
updates.summary: Most new study permit applicants must include a Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) from their destination province, and IRCC caps the number of applications it accepts each year. Plan extra time for the PAL step.
